name: blog-rss-to-slack

trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger — no webhook URL, no backfill across disabled gaps, and no polling_interval_override (durable triggers cannot set one; the classic Zap's was 0/default anyway). DISABLED until the classic 'Share new Blog Posts in Slack' Zap is turned off — running both double-posts every new entry. Cutover: turn the classic Zap off, then `zapier-sdk --experimental enable-workflow 019fffd7-a3e5-733a-b85b-57bea38537c0`.

slack.note: Posts as bot 'BlogBot' with :blogger: icon, unfurl on — identical presentation to the classic Zap.

replaces_classic_zap: Share new Blog Posts in Slack (exported 2026-08-14; RSS new_feed -> filter out /blog/tags & /blog/authors -> Slack channel_message)
